title: dev.matrixmedia.feed_muted
description: Global account data (GET/PUT /_matrix/client/v3/user/{userId}/account_data/{type}): the rooms a user muted in the newsfeed; GET /feed leaves them out. Clients write it under both this name and the legacy com.steegler.matrixmedia.feed_muted, legacy first. While the server's legacy contract is active the legacy copy is the truth: the server reads it first and falls back to this name only when the legacy one does not exist (brief 7.7); after it is retired the order flips. The server also accepts a bare JSON array of room ids.
